result.summary: This PR creates doc/privacy.md as a single home for Bitcoin Core's privacy-related documentation. Commit 1 moves the duplicated 'Privacy recommendations' sections out of doc/tor.md and doc/i2p.md into the new file, replacing them with pointers. Commit 2 adds documentation for the -privatebroadcast option and its related RPCs (getprivatebroadcastinfo, abortprivatebroadcast), which previously had no doc coverage.
result.problem: Privacy guidance was duplicated verbatim across tor.md and i2p.md, and the -privatebroadcast feature (merged via #29415) had no documentation explaining its prerequisites, scope, or related RPCs, leaving users and operators without guidance on using it.

open_concerns: jonatack says the carried-over multi-network unlinkability note is incomplete/potentially misleading because it doesn't explain the 'certain conditions' or address the more common Tor+I2P case; author has agreed to investigate expanding it but has not yet pushed a change.

categories.evidence: PR is entirely documentation changes under doc/, adding doc/privacy.md and updating doc/tor.md, doc/i2p.md, doc/README.md.
categories.rationale: Documents -privatebroadcast, a merged privacy feature with no prior documentation, which is a real gap for users trying to understand its prerequisites and scope. It also removes verbatim-duplicated privacy guidance across tor.md and i2p.md, a moderate clarity win for frequently read setup docs. jonatack's concern that the carried-over unlinkability note is 'incomplete (and perhaps misleading)' is a real content issue but is pre-existing text being relocated, not newly introduced by this PR, and the author is addressing it.

uncertainties: Whether jonatack's flagged wording issue will materially change the diff or is treated as a follow-up improvement.
No maintainer beyond one reviewer has weighed in, so broader project appetite for this specific restructuring is unclear.
result.card: This PR consolidates Bitcoin Core's privacy-related documentation into a new doc/privacy.md, moving duplicated 'Privacy recommendations' text out of tor.md and i2p.md and adding previously missing documentation for the -privatebroadcast option and its related RPCs (getprivatebroadcastinfo, abortprivatebroadcast). The main evidence of value is that -privatebroadcast, a merged feature from #29415, had zero documentation before this PR. Reviewer jonatack gave a Concept ACK but flagged the relocated multi-network unlinkability note as incomplete or potentially misleading given more common Tor+I2P setups; the author agreed and is investigating an expansion, so the PR is Positive w/ caveats rather than fully resolved. The PR is small, CI clean, and ready to review now. No dependencies block it, though it functions as a documentation follow-up to #29415.
